authorization: 2026-11-05 researcher: 好的，推进吧。 Following the accepted bounded proposal; no global retrieval rebuild.
source_scope: 96 train prefixes from the isolated train/dev catalog manifest; filter split before content reads. No test/sealed/deprecated corpus.
selection_inputs: Current prefix and strictly past source texts only. Do not use generated replies or preference outcomes to choose cases. Previously viewed cases remain exposed development.
inclusion: Write a specific information gap absent from the complete current prefix, with an exact current-turn anchor.

Bind an explicit legal past seeker statement that fills that gap and changes an actionable support option, resolves a referent, avoids a concrete contradiction, or avoids asking for information already established as still applicable.
State what reasonable OFF support can already do and an observable disconfirmation; generic extra background, source mention, stylistic preference alone and a similar old mood do not qualify.
Past plans are not completed actions, past states are not automatically current, suggestions by a historical supporter are not seeker preferences.
A complete source conversation must be available and grounded; partial history coverage is disclosed and unresolved temporal conflicts prevent selection.
selection_order: Review all 96 in owner/session/prefix order; each annotated eligibility decision retained. Then round-robin eligible owners in lexicographic owner order, within owner by SHA256(prefix_identity); at most 2 per owner, no duplicate current session. Target one owner each where available.
insufficient_candidates: If fewer than 10 independently eligible cases with valid controls remain, stop this planned generation/human batch and report coverage insufficiency; do not loosen inclusion or manufacture current turns.
target_choice: Choose the most recent complete session resolving the declared gap; if equal date choose stable key. No manually authored summaries, source trimming or desired-answer injection.
distractor_choice: Same-owner strictly past complete session without the target gap information and without a clear current support connection; choose closest native-token length, tie by key. Record mismatch; do not invent or corrupt history.
generation: Frozen Gemma candidate cf84d46eccfb00133963f0b31e80eb323c0fa3c58ba64455b215c1a7dbcf0b3e, unchanged messages renderer and natural EOS; at most 36 distinct calls, 1 actual load, no automatic request retries, no paid fallback. Exact cache reuse checked only after selected cases/resources are frozen.
human_review: At most 12 blinded triplets with common current/legal-source evidence; allow ties, slight/material differences, uncertainty. Exact old judgments reused; no repeated old questions. Obtain direct C/OFF and C/D comparisons rather than aggregate win rates alone.
continuity_checks: Source-anchored wrong referents, contradictions, falsely completed plans, and genuinely redundant questions; asking whether an old state changed is not automatically an error. These checks do not replace helpfulness preference.

decision_gate.joint_win: C preferred over BOTH OFF and D in the same case (slight counts); no source-confirmed factual error providing the apparent advantage.
decision_gate.loss_check: Number of joint wins must exceed number of cases C is judged worse than OFF. Report every loss and material source misuse separately.
decision_gate.pass: Only proceed to a scoped deployable path/latency and feedback study; not a population claim, qualified scalar reward or automatic PPO start.
decision_gate.fail: Stop expanding G tuning/global retrieval/positive-example search for this task under this protocol; report bounded evidence and develop avoidance/latency findings with fixed STOP baseline. No claim contextual RL beats STOP.
decision_gate.technical_or_rating_insufficiency: Report inconclusive/coverage limits; no replacement cases or automatic expansion.

latency: No count-based 3-second inference. Record G components only in this diagnostic; any subsequent deployment decision requires the agreed actual waiting endpoint and complete relevant path.
